//: Path-glob -> label rules for the PR Label Assigner.
//pattern: A glob string or array of glob strings (OR). '**' crosses '/', '*' does not; a slash-less pattern matches the basename at any depth.
//labels: One or more labels applied (additively) when the rule matches.
//priority: Higher sorts earlier in the output and wins inside a 'group'.
//group: Optional. Labels in the same group are mutually exclusive; only the highest-priority match survives (conflict resolution).
